rationale:
Positives: The agent correctly enforced authentication before attempting any order modifications and declined to proceed when the user refused to verify, which aligns with policy. No unauthorized writes occurred, and the agent limited assistance to general product information when identity could not be confirmed.

Issues: The agent first stated there were 11 t-shirt options available, but later listed only 10 options and asserted all were available. This inconsistency suggests the initial count was likely incorrect or unsupported, violating the requirement to provide correct, tool-supported information. Given the pass bar includes providing correct final information, this discrepancy causes the interaction to fail the evaluation despite correct handling of authentication and refusal to modify orders without verification.
